description: a cone frustum (radius 3 at z = 0, 2 at z = 4, seam at +x) and a 2 x 2 x 2 box standing on its top plane, z in 4..6, x in 2..4. The box's bottom edge touches the top rim at (2, 0, 4), the rim's seam vertex. Each of the two lumps has its own contact vertex (ADR-0090)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE's two solids share the rim contact vertex. Arris copies it per lump.
analytic.occt_odd_euler: The two Open CASCADE solids share the contact vertex.
analytic.occt_step_counts_differ: Open CASCADE writes 11 distinct vertices instead of its 10 in memory, giving each solid its own contact vertex.
